dense10_sparse10_fill_dense_then_sparse: 1. Append BGE-M3 dense ranks 1–10 in order, skipping duplicates.
2. Append BGE-M3 sparse ranks 1–10 in order, skipping duplicates.
3. If fewer than 20, append remaining dense ranks 11–30, skipping duplicates.
4. If still fewer than 20, append remaining sparse ranks 11–30, skipping duplicates.
interleave_dense_sparse_fill_dense_then_: 1. Walk rank i = 1, 2, … adding dense[i] then sparse[i], skipping duplicates, until 20.
2. If fewer than 20, fill remaining dense ranks then remaining sparse ranks.
dense15_sparse5_fill_dense_then_sparse: 3. Fill remaining dense ranks, then remaining sparse ranks.

selection_rule.reason: Pick the rule with the most gold passages across all four books, then the fewest losses versus hybrid top 20, then the fewest books where coverage is worse than the baseline. Same rule for every book.
